LanguageData.RSMF.CustomSign.CanvasHelp: Click and drag a layer to position it. Use the controls for precise size and angle. Center or reset brings an off-canvas image back into view.
LanguageData.RSMF.CustomSign.InheritedPreview: This direction currently uses the south layers. Add an image to configure it separately. West shares and mirrors the east layers.
LanguageData.RSMF.CustomSign.EmptyLayers: No layers on this face. Use the buttons below to add a gallery image or import a picture.
LanguageData.RSMF.CustomSign.OffsetHelp: Position is relative to the sign face: 0 is the center, with a range of -1 to 1. Lock aspect ratio preserves the current proportions; disable it to stretch each axis independently.
LanguageData.RSMF.CustomSign.GalleryHelp: Browse large previews before choosing an image. Imported pictures stay in your local gallery for reuse.
LanguageData.RSMF.CustomSign.EmptyGallery: No matching images. Clear the search or import a PNG or JPG using the button below.
